session.expiredBody: உங்கள் பாதுகாப்பிற்காக நீங்கள் வெளியேற்றப்பட்டீர்கள். தொடர மீண்டும் உள்நுழையவும்.

common.scaffold: S1 scaffold — this screen is implemented in S2/S3 per the sprint plan.

queue.title: Live queue
queue.description: Patients appear here as they check in, in arrival order.
queue.empty: No patients waiting. Check-ins will appear here in real time.
queue.degradedBanner: Live updates are unavailable. Showing the last known queue; retrying in the background.
queue.sessionExpired: உங்கள் அமர்வு காலாவதியாகிவிட்டது. நேரலை புதுப்பிப்புகளைத் தொடர மீண்டும் உள்நுழையவும்.

search.title: நோயாளியைத் தேடுங்கள்
search.description: பெயர், PHN அல்லது தொலைபேசி மூலம் தேடுங்கள். பதிவைத் திறக்க செயலில் உள்ள சிகிச்சை உறவு தேவை.

patient.title: Patient session
patient.summaryPlaceholder: Photo, age, sex, blood group, allergy chips and active medications render here from the core-api summary endpoint.
patient.chatPlaceholder: Cited chat over this patient's record streams here via the agent-service.
patient.chatIntro: Ask about this patient's record. Answers are grounded in the FHIR chart and cite their sources.
patient.chatError: The assistant hit an error. Please retry.
patient.proposalOverride: Needs an override reason — use the sign-off panel below

portal.title: My health
portal.greeting: Your records, appointments, reminders and consent controls will live here.
portal.languageNote: English · සිංහල · தமிழ் — the language switcher is permanent in the header from day 1.
portal.greetingNamed: Welcome, {name}. Here is your health record.
portal.noRecord: No health record is linked to your account yet. Please see reception.
portal.loadError: We could not load your record right now. Please try again shortly.
portal.accessLogIntro: Every time a clinician records or changes something in your record, it is logged here.
portal.exportIntro: உங்கள் சுகாதாரப் பதிவின் நகலைப் பெறுங்கள். ஒவ்வொரு பதிவிறக்கமும் உங்கள் அணுகல் பதிவேட்டில் பதிவாகும்.

kiosk.title: Welcome
kiosk.subtitle: Look at the camera to check in

recognised.title: You're checked in
recognised.body: Please take a seat. You'll be called shortly.

notRecognised.title: Let's check you in at the desk
notRecognised.body: Please see the receptionist — they'll find your record and check you in. This never affects your care.
notRecognised.assistNote: A staff member has been notified to assist you.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: The error has been reported. You can retry, or contact support with the reference below.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

proposal.intro: Draft a prescription and check it against this patient's record before signing.
proposal.overridePrompt: This is a caution. Enter a clinical reason to override and proceed.
proposal.overrideRequired: A warning was raised — an override reason is required to sign.
proposal.blocked: Blocked by the safety engine — this cannot be prescribed.
proposal.footnote: The deterministic Rx-safety engine is the authority; the record is re-screened on commit. Every sign-off is audited.

consent.faceExplain: Face check-in lets you check in at the clinic camera instead of the desk. You can turn it off any time.
consent.error: Could not update consent. Please try again.
consent.effect: Changes take effect immediately. Turning off also asks the face service to delete your face data.
